## KB / Documentation checklist

- [ ] I ran the KB validation scripts locally: `./scripts/kb-change-summary.sh`
- [ ] No duplicate titles or aliases were introduced
- [ ] Frontmatter includes: `title`, `created`, `modified`, `type`
- [ ] If adding or renaming tags, `tags.yml` was updated with canonical mapping
- [ ] Owners impacted by this change were notified (see KB_OWNERS.md)
